Selected work

Seven academic and collaborative projects spanning fragrance, beauty, fashion, jewelry, hospitality and editorial publishing. Each case study is clearly identified and focused on the thinking behind the visuals.

01 · Academic concept

L’Après

Jacquemus fragrance campaign

A fragrance concept built around what remains after someone leaves: warmth in a room, a familiar trace and the quiet persistence of memory. The campaign translates an intimate emotional territory into product, image, film, print and retail touchpoints.

My roleStrategy, storytelling, copywriting and art direction
DeliverablesFragrance concept, visual language and integrated campaign
Skills shownEmotional branding, creative direction and channel planning
02 · Academic 360° campaign

Versace: The Attitude

Brand platform and cultural campaign

A complete communication campaign designed to reconnect Versace with unapologetic self-expression. Research and positioning lead into a creative platform, manifesto, cast, influencer strategy, exhibition, content plan, budget and performance framework.

My roleResearch, strategy, concept development and art direction
Deliverables360° channel plan, influence, exhibition, budget and KPIs
Skills shownIntegrated communication, audience strategy and campaign planning
03 · Academic communication strategy

For Them

Bottega Veneta luxury pet accessories

A communication strategy for an imagined Bottega Veneta pet-accessories extension. The proposal protects the house’s quiet-luxury codes while introducing a warm, emotionally relevant category through editorial storytelling, product placement, digital content and retail experience.

My roleCommunication strategy, messaging and campaign planning
DeliverablesTargets, key messages, content actions and launch calendar
Skills shownLuxury positioning, content ecosystems and activation planning
04 · Academic beauty concept

The Inner Spectrum

Chanel Beauty immersive experience

A beauty concept exploring how emotion can become color. Inspired by neuroscience and sensory perception, the project imagines a personalized lip experience that translates individual emotional responses into a unique shade and an immersive luxury journey.

My roleConcept development, research, storytelling and art direction
DeliverablesProduct concept, visual identity, location and customer experience
Skills shownBeauty innovation, experiential design and emotional branding
05 · Academic brand platform

Nadine Ghosn

A playful activation system

A refreshed brand approach that turns Nadine Ghosn’s playful design language into a coherent communication system. The strategy connects fine jewelry with food, conversation and culture through social content, influencer seeding, editorial imagery and an experiential dinner.

My roleBrand strategy, creative concepts and visual direction
DeliverablesBrand platform, content series, seeding and cultural activations
Skills shownSocial thinking, influencer activation and editorial storytelling
06 · Editorial research project

Fashion & Gastronomy

Hospitality, collaborations and food trends

An editorial publication examining how fashion brands use cafés, restaurants, food collaborations and viral culinary trends to build culture and community. The project moves from brand hospitality to collaboration case studies and emerging food phenomena.

My roleResearch, trend analysis, editorial writing and visual direction
DeliverablesMagazine concept, feature articles and visual trend stories
Skills shownCultural intelligence, editorial design and cross-industry analysis
07 · Collaborative editorial project

Étude

Fashion magazine · Denim issue

A fashion magazine dedicated to wardrobe essentials, with denim as the issue’s central subject. Articles, styling and original imagery explore denim as a cultural object shaped by rebellion, utility, imperfection and personal identity.

My contributionEditorial writing, art direction, photography and research
FormatPrint-oriented magazine with reported and visual features
Skills shownEditorial judgment, visual storytelling and cultural research
Collaboration note: Étude was created as a group project. The responsibilities listed here refer specifically to my contribution.

About

Paris-based, internationally minded and comfortable moving from research to concept, then from concept to execution.

I am a Master’s student in Digital Marketing & Communication at ISCOM Paris and a Fashion Business, Marketing & Communication graduate from LISAA Mode Paris.

My approach combines cultural research, strategic thinking and a strong visual eye. I work in French and English, with Arabic as my mother tongue.
